steps.name: Ashen Stain (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Sarasvati] in 「Isolation Room 3」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I sent you a message because new memories of yours were detected in the hyperspace network, %s. Please access it again, as you did last time...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did get some sleep, but I must still be tired. So many things have happened at once... I should be all right now...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Could you tell me what you have experienced recently?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Sarasvati about your visit to Elysia.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: That is hard to believe... To think there is yet another world...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Though I have identified several worlds myself, so I should not say that... Not as an administrator...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Then do I just place my hand here, like last time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why can't I see it?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: An error message says the operation cannot be performed right now. Checking the logs, it seems certain conditions must be met.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The spirit of time in Pneuma stopped for a moment, a very brief moment, because of something the god Hecate did. That caused time in Etoile to waver.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: And the spacetime network was affected too, though only very slightly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would like you to ask Elysia's administrator.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The administrator...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I will see whether I can change the conditions, just in case. But please visit Elysia once...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Oh, adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Sarasvati. Sorry.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you are reluctant, you do not have to do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll go... But what should I ask?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Hmm... 'Memories' seems like a good keyword.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Sarasvati. I'll go right away.

steps.name: Ashen Stain (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」, collect 100 <Agni's Mana Hall>, then turn in the quest to [Irfan].

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: So you have come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I thought you would return someday, but I did not expect it to be so soon.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Well, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I somehow felt I needed to come back.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You are not being honest. I do not know whether this will answer that feeling, but I will help you a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I am speaking now, am I not? Listen quietly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How do you remember what happened in the Jude Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went from Freios to Eastland to find Iris. And then...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What did you experience in the Jude Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I confronted the chief of the Agni clan, who had been used by Ban and Mara... Wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I was... of the Agni clan...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of the Agni clan...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Just as I thought.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even when you came to Elysia, you did not recognize your identity as an Agni.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Depending on your choice, I may be able to help. As a former chief of the clan, it is only natural that I help a descendant.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What will you do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You seem unwilling. Then go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. That's not it... I'll do it.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Again, this is your choice. I am merely offering a little help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I never expected to find a descendant like you... But it cannot be helped.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Bring me a few objects from Eastland. Here in Elysia, they will awaken your forgotten memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What objects do you need?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Bring plenty of the [Agni Mana Holes] hidden in the [Sun God's Underground Altar]. Those objects, filled with the will of flame, should suffice.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then I will tell you what to bring next.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

steps.name: Ashen Stain (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」, collect 100 each of <Serpent Shadow's Horn> and <Serpent Shadow's Scale> in 「Star of the Void」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan].

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You have returned?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: These Mana Holes are the materialized power of Agni, the sun god. They contain something close to its very source.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, do you see?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The ones you brought glow a deeper red than the Mana Holes I know.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Think of it as a gift from Elysia, where the ancient gods once dwelled... Press the Mana Holes you brought against your chest.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I would like to call your suspicion prudence, but it does not suit an Agni.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.
(The moment the Mana Hole touches %s's chest, the burning crystal turns into flame and plunges inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: M-My head is burning. I... I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaagh!!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: This is how the Agni clan overcomes fear. Do not be afraid. Think of it as your own soul awakening...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Hah, hah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That should do. Does anything come to mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When Ban and Mara attacked the village, my father told me to escape to a hidden, secret altar... He said he would save the village as its chief...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And so I went to the sacred land, and by the will of the goddess Seres, began my journey...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The beginning of your journey to find the one who would become God of the Astral Realm. So what happened when you reached the Jude Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The clan attacked the Jude Kingdom because of Ban and Mara's magic stones. To save the clan, my father had no choice...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What happened after that?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You still do not recognize that part of your soul is Agni. You will have to make another trip.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: There is a snake that appears from time to time on the Star of the Void, across the ages. The Snake's Shadow, was it? You defeated its most recent appearance, correct?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It appeared before too?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I saw that snake once during my lifetime. The way it licked its lips, eager to devour souls, was quite memorable. It soon concealed itself, though...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It said itself that it had swallowed souls. Something belonging to such a snake may be able to help you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you visit the Star of the Void, something should still remain. Bring plenty, as you did with the Mana Holes.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What are you standing there for? Be grateful this is not a trial...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

steps.name: Ashen Stain (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」, then return to [Sarasvati] in 「Isolation Room 3」. Talk to her and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You look very tired.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Use your power to combine the Snake's Shadow's horns and scales and grind them to powder. The heat flowing from your Gigant Pole should be sufficient.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then gather the powder in both hands and pray for your soul, like the hot sands of the desert, to awaken.
(As Irfan instructs, you grind the Snake's Shadow's horns and scales to powder and gather it in your hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this right?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Close your eyes and pray.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guh...
(The powder in your hands turns to flame, racing up %s's arms toward the head.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Do not be frightened. Under your soul's influence, the sun's flame within you has merely ignited as a purifying flame.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaaaaagh!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's... burning...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaagh!!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You are filled with fear...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why... Why did I... Father...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Your memories from that time have awakened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irfan, why did I... My father... My father...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Do not be alarmed. Listen to me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: In the newly arranged timeline, Aslan was given a chance. You must have wondered about it all. About the strange behavior of people in the Jude Kingdom...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The king of the Jude Kingdom forgave his friend Aslan and showed mercy, allowing him to reflect on his actions in prison.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: He had cooperated with the enemy, but what happened was not Aslan's doing...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: In that timeline, you settled matters in the Jude Kingdom and headed to Lumen as though nothing had happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. That's what I did... But...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That was you, and the memories now returning are also yours.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I resented the father who helped me escape. I treated him as an enemy and fought him in anger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should never have done that. How could I dare do that to my father...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The Aslan of that timeline was powerless. He must have wanted to die. Even at the hands of his beloved child, he would have wanted to erase the grief of losing his clan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And so, in that timeline, you killed Aslan and continued your journey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Do not grieve too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How could I do that to my father...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: But that timeline was altered. You may not like hearing it, but it was Lady Hecate who changed part of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I do not know why Lady Hecate did so. What is certain is that a being above even the ancient gods wanted that timeline.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Your collapse and downfall, and the destruction of the world...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You must know as well. Across the branching timelines, you have taken many different forms.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't deny it... There was the Drifting City, too...)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: One of those is you, here and now. A descendant of the Agni clan.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irfan... I...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You mean Aslan?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The Aslan of this time will not remember you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: When time was altered, Aslan became someone who had no child...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why... Why did it turn out that way?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Lady Hecate's actions aside, the power Lady Iris used to save you became intertwined with them, producing this result.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: A god does not wish her own follower to become an Agasura. Especially if you, a descendant of the sun god, were to change... It could bring about the worst possible outcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Things are best as they are, both for you, with so much still ahead, and for Aslan, who dreams of rebuilding his clan from his underground prison.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What do you think would happen if you visited Aslan and told him the truth...?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It would also harm the timeline of Lady Iris, who saved you...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: For now, there is no answer. This is the best we can do...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: In any case, you must live with these memories planted in your mind. Whether you like it or not, they are part of who you are...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you helping me?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Because we belong to the same clan.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I were one of my other selves...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then that would have been a different story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I hope next time we speak of a new story that is yours alone, instead of this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go back now... Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It seems you have suffered quite a shock...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Your tears may dampen the flame in your heart for now, but it will soon use them as fuel and blaze again...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, you have returned?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Did you receive an answer from Elysia's administrator?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a little difficult to explain...
(Seeing %s's troubled expression, Sarasvati nods in understanding.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It is all right. The problem has been resolved, but whether to use it is your decision.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I have created a separate secure folder. Come and access it whenever you wish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sarasvati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: That aside, the keyword 'memories' that you carry still seems to affect the hyperspace network in various ways.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The error corrected itself at some point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did it?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you access it later, you will be able to review some of your memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Sarasvati. I'll head back down now. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes... Goodbye...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Today's adventurer is code name Agni...
